The Academy is now a preeminent scientific institution within the Star Empire. Its graduates - not just scholars, but master tacticians and military strategists - are considered vital assets. They are sought after by the military and intelligence services for their unparalleled ability to translate theoretical knowledge into strategic advantage.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_3_vulcan_desc:
Research Facility

Now a premier scientific institution, the Academy's influence is felt throughout the quadrant. Its research and development divisions are responsible for a continuous stream of new innovations and discoveries, making it a source of immense pride for the Vulcan people.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_andor_desc:
Research Facility

This is less a building and more of a cultural cornerstone. The Academy's campus now spans an entire region, with a staff of renowned masters and a curriculum that covers every known art form. It is the premier artistic institution in the galaxy, a testament to the Andorian mind.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_bajor_desc:
Research Facility

This is no longer just a university—it is the intellectual heart of the Bajoran system. Its faculty includes the greatest minds in both theology and science, and its graduates are at the forefront of every major advancement and cultural development. It is a true testament to the strength and wisdom of the Bajoran people.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_banea_desc:
Research Facility

The Banean Engineering Institute is now an interstellar monument to technical excellence. Its faculty includes the greatest Banean minds, and its students pioneer advancements in fields previously thought impossible, such as advanced sensor jamming and warp field theory.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_betazed_desc:
Research Facility

The University of Betazed is the premier institution of its kind in the quadrant. Its faculty includes the greatest Betazoid scholars, and its advanced programs attract students from many allied species. It is a beacon of intellectual curiosity, compassionate understanding, and deep respect for history and culture.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_cardassia_desc:
Research Facility

This is less a university and more of an arm of the Cardassian state. Its graduates are the elite of Cardassian society, and its faculty are the architects of the Union's ideology. The institution is the ultimate tool for both fostering intellectualism and ensuring absolute loyalty.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_denobulan_desc:
Research Facility

The Denobulan Science Academy is a wonder of the galaxy, its reputation and influence unmatched. Its alumni are considered the greatest scientific minds in their fields, and its research has led to countless breakthroughs in medicine, technology, and pure science.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_desc:
Research Facility

Students from nearby worlds attend this facility, with academic leaders in every branch, teaching seminars every day. A higher level of education amongst our citizens will improve our ability to make new discoveries and advance our scientific understanding.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_earth_desc:
Research Facility

The University of Cambridge is now a monumental institution, its reputation for academic excellence unmatched throughout humanity. Its alumni are considered the greatest scientific minds in their fields, and its research has led to countless breakthroughs that benefit all species.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_orion_desc:
Research Facility

This is a monument to the Orion mind and its uncompromising ambition. The Institute's research on cosmology and spacetime anomalies is a closely guarded asset, and its curriculum produces the elite, results-oriented professionals who are indispensable to Orion commerce and clandestine operations.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_rom_desc:
Research Facility

This is a monument to the Romulan mind and its uncompromising ambition. The Academy's research is a closely guarded asset, and its curriculum produces the elite, results-oriented professionals who are indispensable to the continued power of the Star Empire and the Tal Shiar.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_school_4_vulcan_desc:
Research Facility

This is less a building and more of a galactic scientific monument. The Academy's influence is woven into the very fabric of scientific progress, and its graduates are at the forefront of every major discovery. It is the definitive voice of scientific authority in the quadrant.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_secret_1_cardassian_desc:
Government Facility

The Obsidian Order is the primary intelligence agency of the Cardassian Union. Almost all Cardassians live in fear of the Obsidian Order, whose constant surveillance had led to the sudden eliminations of numerous 'traitors'. It is said that The Order is so efficient, a Cardassian citizen couldn't sit down to a meal without each dish being duly noted and recorded by the Order, down to its preparation and the exact measurement of each ingredient. 'Everyone has reason to fear the Order.'

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_confederacy_desc:
Government Facility

The Confederacy Intelligence agency or CIA are responsible for the internal security of the Confederation with the jurisdiction to employ any means to accomplish the task.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_dominion_desc:
Government Facility

The Dominion Security Division are responsible for maintaining the security and protection of the Dominion and to ensure the Founders are never without the knowledge to keep the Dominion above its enemies.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_generic_desc:
Government Facility

It takes exceptional people to do what we do - To share glorious news of our greatness with our beloved citizens. Our reporters, newsreaders, editors and publicists ensure our citizens are given the correct information about our activities, rather than any dissident propaganda.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_romulan_desc:
Government Facility

The Tal Shiar is the elite intelligence agency of the Romulan Star Empire. It is a highly-respected and feared force in the Alpha and Beta Quadrants. Its purpose is guarding the security of the Empire, both from the Romulans' interstellar enemies - as well as from traitors within the Romulan population itself. The covert, often invisible presence of the Tal Shiar keeps the general populace in a constant state of paranoia. Dissent and dissatisfaction with the status quo is met with severe punishment and dissidents are often known to 'disappear'.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_starfleet_desc:
Government Facility

Starfleet Intelligence is a law enforcement and intelligence agency within Starfleet responsible for state security and citizen safety.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_1_terran_desc:
Government Facility

Imperial Intelligence, also referred to as Starfleet Intelligence or Imperial Security, is a law-enforcement and intelligence agency of the Terran Empire that is charged with matters of state security and ensuring the loyalty of citizens to the Empire. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_cardassian_desc:
Government Facility

With a renovated headquarters, the Obsidian Order has expanded its reach far beyond the Cardassian Union. Its agents now operate in a new capacity, monitoring and manipulating events in neighboring systems. Advanced data analysis engines allow the Order to predict and neutralize threats to Cardassian interests before they even materialize. The new HQ serves not only as a centre of intelligence but as the nerve centre for pre-emptive operations, ensuring the Order's grip on both domestic and interstellar affairs.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_romulan_desc:
Government Facility

With this renovated facility, the Tal Shiar has perfected its network of spies and informants. State-of-the-art surveillance and interrogation facilities ensure that no secret, no matter how deeply buried, remains hidden from the Empire's gaze. The new headquarters is more than a building; it is a symbol of the Tal Shiar's total authority, a constant reminder that its unseen agents are everywhere, watching and listening for the slightest hint of disloyalty.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_starfleet_desc:
Government Facility

Starfleet Intelligence now represents a new generation of information management. This facility is dedicated to the proactive protection of Federation space and its ideals. It houses a state-of-the-art data analysis hub, where intelligence gathered from countless sources is meticulously cross-referenced to anticipate threats. Rather than merely reacting to crises, the Advanced HQ works to identify and neutralise them at their earliest stages, ensuring the continued safety and prosperity of all Federation citizens.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_2_terran_desc:
Government Facility

Time takes a toll on everything, being in the shadows doesnt exclude that from happening. While renovated it was also enhanced on several aspects, which i cant tell, otherwise it wouldnt be a secret.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_3_cardassian_desc:
Government Facility

This headquarters has been upgraded to house the Order's most effective and ruthless 'eliminators.' With a sprawling network of informants, state-of-the-art surveillance technologies, and a direct line to every major military asset, the Order is now able to act with total impunity. From this location, every move of every citizen, every military order, and every political machination is known and recorded. This new facility ensures no whisper of dissent or treason goes unpunished.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_3_romulan_desc:
Government Facility

This facility represents the pinnacle of Romulan intelligence. It is a fortress of both information and lethality, where advanced cognitive analysis and psi-scanners are used to predict the strategic moves of rivals and identify traitors before they can act. The 'Enhanced' HQ is less about gathering secrets and more about controlling the flow of information on a galactic scale, ensuring the Tal Shiar always holds the crucial advantage. Dissent is not merely punished here; it is erased from existence.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_3_terran_desc:
Government Facility

Further enhanced and bigger, its so big you can not see. Realy, its hiding in plain sight and no one knows about it. Maybe we should remove the 'Intelligence HQ' sign at the entrance.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Government Facility.
building_secret_s31_starfleet_desc:
Government Facility

On the outside this building looks like any other on the planet, but within the secretive Section 31 coordinate their efforts to protect the citizens of Earth and its allies from within this building.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_slave_agony_1_desc:
Government Facility

Built for interrogations of slaves, these chambers are large scale agony booths - capable of stimulating the pain centre of virtually any humanoid with a synaptic scan calibrating it for each species. The booth's sensors continually shifts the stimulation from one nerve cluster to another, keeping the subject in a constant state of agony.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_slave_bazaar_desc:
Criminal Syndicate

Highly illegal on some worlds, the lucrative slave bazaar is large auctioneering area which allows the procurement of individuals who have been sold into indentured slavery.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Criminal Syndicate.
building_slave_camp_1_desc:
Government Facility

The buying and selling of slaves for usage for labour, research or pleasure has been a staple of business for centuries. With the introduction of new species and new markets, demand has spiked, allowing this facility to operate on a planetary wide scale. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_spawning_pool_1_desc:
Population Assembly

Grown in thick viscous goo filled with all the nutrients a growing body could need, the spawning pools are where many clones are born.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Population Assembly.
building_spawning_pool_2_desc:
Population Assembly

Tubes filled with the growing clones are kept here, suspended in a thick viscous gloop that contains all the nutrients and minerals a growing clone needs. Attached biomonitors can be closely monitored to ensure optimum growth.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Population Assembly.
building_spawning_pool_3_desc:
Population Assembly

The process of growing clones within vast rows of tubes has been automated somewhat, with the automatic release of nutrients, growth hormones or poison dependent on the central monitoring stations situated within the complex. 

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Population Assembly.
building_spawning_pool_4_desc:
Population Assembly

This vast cloning facility has rows upon rows of specimens growing within large cylindrical tubes filled with a whitish grey gloop. The process is fully automated with monitoring software responsible for the growth, birthing and recycling of subjects.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Population Assembly.
building_starport_1_desc:
Manufacturing Building

Not much more than a clearing and some basic facilities for civilian freighters and trading ships, the basic trading centre is meant to make way to a range of specialised commercial buildings.

Trading Centres allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported goods. The imported good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_starport_2_desc:
Manufacturing Building

A nexus for intra-system and interstellar civilian freighters, starports are a major hub of commerce. Most financial institutions and commodity exchanges keep at least a nominal presence in this giant facility, if not their main planetary headquarters.

Starports allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported goods. The imported good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_starport_3_desc:
Manufacturing Building

An enormous trading hub for interstellar civilian freighters and traders. Most interstellar financial institutions and commodity exchanges have a large presence here, if not their main planetary headquarters.

Commercial Hubs allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported good. The imported goods on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_starport_4_desc:
Manufacturing Building

The headquarters of many interstellar commerce organisations, this starport is an immense trading port designed as a hub to service nearby worlds.

Commercial Nexus allow the player to trade latinum for a range of possible imported goods. The imported good on this planet can be controlled and adjusted via the Decisions menu.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Manufacturing Building.
building_stone_of_memory_desc:
Resource Building

Recordings of memories from deep within the rock are stored here, etched deep within the stonework.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_supercomputer_1_desc:
Research Facility

The sophisticated master computer on the planet Bynaus is with which virtually all Bynar are interconnected. It is an integral part of Bynar society, influencing their language and even their thought patterns.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_tholian_hub_1_desc:
Unity Building

The lattice is what binds all Tholians together, for it is what has always binded all Tholians together. Being in proximity to a lattice node brings a sense of calm and unity to the population.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_tholian_hub_2_desc:
Unity Building

The lattice is what binds all Tholians together, for it is what has always binded all Tholians together. Being in proximity to where numerous lattice nodes converge brings a sense of calm and unity to the population.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
building_tholian_hub_3_desc:
Unity Building

The lattice is what binds all Tholians together, for it is what has always binded all Tholians together. The confluence of large sections of the lattice here exude massive amounts of calm and unity across the surface of the world.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
building_tholian_hub_4_desc:
Unity Building

The central nexus of the lattice, where all points meet in a large hub, is a powerful area where Tholians meet to experience the calm and unity that the lattice brings.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
building_time_crystal_mine_1_desc:
Resource Building

Time crystals are a very rare mineral in a non-equilibrium matter state. Time crystals can be identified by their orthogonal indices. Careful mining techniques are able to harvest this mineral, which is used in rare temporal experiments.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_tosk_refuge_desc:
Unity Building

A vast contained ecosystem where Tosk can roam free to create an ideal hunting grounds for the Oschean Hunters.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_training_centre_1_desc:
Military Facility

Whilst headquarters can often produce the best and the brightest, more members of the populace can be trained to traverse the stars, though it may take more resources.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_training_centre_2_desc:
Military Facility

Whilst headquarters can often produce the best and the brightest, gaining real experience with live fire exercises and actual ships is an important part of ensuring crews are experienced.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_trellium_mine_1_desc:
Resource Building

Whilst some forms of Trellium can be produced synthetically, the most useful forms are found in natural ore. Deep core mining allows the Trellium to be extracted from the ground and processed into a useable form.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Resource Building.
building_tribute_humanity_desc:
Unity Building

A site that is dedicated to spreading the message and glory of Humanity, so that none forget 'a Human Galaxy is a safe Galaxy'.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_underground_market_1_desc:
Government Facility

An underground market is a clandestine market for transactions that have some aspect of illegality. Crime is rife here.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Government Facility.
building_undine_academy_1_desc:
Military Facility

The construction of a local garrison that grows from the local biomass and gathers to defend a small section of territory.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
building_undine_academy_2_desc:
Military Facility

Improvements to the garrison allow for a more permanent defensive force to infest in this system at the Division Headquarters, which is able to respond to any assaults rapidly across the planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Military Facility.
building_undine_academy_3_desc:
Military Facility

The headquarters of our orbital armies is a fortified command and control stronghold, filled with numerous divisions of defensive troops capable of coordinating the defences across the entire planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Military Facility.
building_undine_academy_4_desc:
Military Facility

A massive hardened and purpose built set of structures with large tunnel complexes under the surface allow for entire armies of units to be stationed in this fortress, able to defend against massed assaults by invading armies.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Military Facility.
building_undine_arena_desc:
Amenity Building

The Undine do not socialise like normal species, but the Hive Arena allows them to test their psychic powers and encourage others from their species to watch and enjoy the entertainment.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_undine_capital_1_desc:
Capitol Building

Small local hive where the Undine can convene in their natural environment. The local Psi Master can coordinate the actions of the hive and allow the site to develop.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Capital Facility.
building_undine_capital_2_desc:
Capitol Building

This Hive allows the coordination of the Undine population though a series of nodes that connect internally within the planet itself. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_undine_capital_3_desc:
Capitol Building

As we establish further control over the world, we are announcing to the rest of the galaxy that this planet is under the control of the biomass.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_undine_capital_4_desc:
Capitol Building

This world has now almost completely succumb to the biomass of Fluidic Space. The planet is more like a single organism than a planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_undine_capital_5_desc:
Capitol Building

The entire planet brims with the psychic energy of the Undine, with everything moving and acting as one. All life acting to further the supremacy of the fluidic realm.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_undine_engineering_1_desc:
Research Facility

The Engineering Advancement Hive brings together the greatest minds in Undine society to telepathically work through ideas and make advancements.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_physics_1_desc:
Research Facility

The Physics commune brings together the greatest minds in Undine society to telepathically work through ideas and make advancements.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_police_hive_1_desc:
Law Enforcement Facility

Order is maintained within the hive via the local order depots, errant individuals are identified and removed from the group.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_undine_police_hive_2_desc:
Law Enforcement Facility

Balancing the cohesion of the multiple minds takes careful coordination to ensure errant individuals to do corrupt the wider group.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_undine_police_hive_3_desc:
Law Enforcement Facility

These segments allow for errant minds that are behaving against the good of the species to be captured and repaired before further damage to the group union can be done.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_undine_police_hive_4_desc:
Law Enforcement Facility

The cohesion of the group is important, and large Hive Order complexes are designed to ensure cohesion, and rectify any errant Undine.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Law Enforcement Facility.
building_undine_research_lab_1_desc:
Research Facility

The Undine Research Pool allows the Undine to gather and telepathically process and stores information relevant to current events, before communing with other hives.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_research_lab_2_desc:
Research Facility

The Undine Research Archive processes and stores information uploaded from the minds of the Undine scientists and stores it for long term usage and archival.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_research_lab_3_desc:
Research Facility

The Planetary Research Pool serves as a neural database of an entire world. It coordinates the work of Undine Research Archives and smooth information distribution to the entire planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_research_lab_4_desc:
Research Facility

The Interdimensional Research Archive coordinates the work of individual Planetary Research Pool and projects this information into the mines of Undine hives across dimensions.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_society_1_desc:
Research Facility

Undine biology is as close to perfection as possible, yet their genetists still work to advance their perfection by studying all branches in the field of biology.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
building_undine_temple_desc:
Unity Building

Discovered on the planet, the ruins of an ancient Undine temple holding many secrets.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
building_undine_toiler_outpost_desc:
Undine Special Building

The Undine Toilers scower the fluidic realm to bring in resources to strenghten the hive. Their Outposts allow them to collect their harvested supplies and coordinate their efforts.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Undine Special Building.
building_university_capital_2_desc:
Capitol Building

Controlling the free flow and access of information throughout the university campuses requires a large capital which is capable of handling the gathering of the best minds on the planet.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_university_capital_3_desc:
Capitol Building

Controlling the free flow and access of information throughout the university campuses requires a large capital which is also capable of handling the massive computations of the researchers.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Capital Facility.
building_university_capital_4_desc:
Capitol Building

Controlling the free flow and access of information throughout the university campuses requires a large capital which is also capable of handling massive amounts of data going in and out of the capital.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Capital Facility.
building_university_capital_5_desc:
Capitol Building

Controlling the free flow and access of information throughout the university campuses requires a large capital which is capable of handling anything the scientific mind can throw at it. 

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Capital Facility.
building_verteron_array_desc:
Resource Building

The highly advanced and specialised Verteron Array can be used to divert comets from their solar orbit and force them to crash on Mars polar ice caps.

The Verteron Array may only be built on Mars. It will allow a special decision for the terraforming process for Mars.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Resource Building.
building_weather_control_facility_desc:
Amenity Building

A weather control system is used to alter a planet's natural weather patterns and local system through a weather control grid that which acts much like a system-wide environmental system.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
building_wilderness_capital_2_desc:
Capitol Building

The Hunter's Cabin is the centralised location on a hunting planet where most hunting parties arrange their expeditions, as well as present their trophies and claim their rewards.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Capital Facility.
building_xeno_zoo_1_desc:
Cultural Building

A facility containing biomes different to our own can be constructed to exhibit and study alien, non-sentient life for the enjoyment and benefit of our citizens.

This building requires a specific deposit on a planet to be able to be built.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Cultural Building.
building_xeno_zoo_denobulan_desc:
Academic Facility

A large centre for Xenological studies created by the Denobulans in order to study alien life and understand their unique familial and cultural differences.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Academic Facility.
district_admin_desc: Reserved for governmental and military use, these administrative districts are under the direct control of the government.
district_admin_hive_desc: The central processing focus offers command and control over vast portions of the world.
district_admin_spec_fortress_naval_desc: Prototypes and new experimental designs are constructed and trialed within the Skunkworks.
district_admin_spec_hunting_luxuries_des: Conservation sites and breeding grounds stock these hunting preserves for rare prey, offering rare and luxurious trophies.
district_admin_spec_penal_guard_desc: Penal colonies require suitable barracks to house the multitude of security staff.
district_admin_spec_resort_luxuries_desc: Resort worlds are filled with entertainment, from sporting events and entertaining shows, to more physical and mental stimulating activities such as Jamaharon.
district_admin_spec_retreat_dig_desc: Large dig sites uncovering the ruins of a world and society long past.
district_admin_spec_retreat_monastery_de: Monasteries are complexes of buildings comprising the domestic quarters and workplaces of many religious and spiritual members.
district_admin_undine_desc: Communes where Psi Masters can telepathically organise the horde.
district_city_slums_desc: Simple housing blocks make up the accomodation in the slums, with many units falling into disrepair almost immediately.
district_city_village_desc: Often located in rural areas, villages are small clusters of housing made available for the population of this world.
district_domed_city_desc: A domed city is a large settlement enclosed within a protective dome with extensive systems for housing, transportation, sanitation, utilities, land use, and communication.
district_energy_node_desc: Vast nodes allow for unprecedented energy production and storage.
district_farming_CPM_desc: The production of Chromodynamic Power Cores is focused within these districts, with all industries dedicated to the sole production of CPMs.
district_farming_hunting_desc: Filled with prey, these hunting grounds allow hunters to hone their skills and provide a food source at the same time.
district_farming_hydroponic_desc: Growing plants in the absence of soil with the help of hydroponics.
district_farming_nanites_desc: Large computer banks make up the analysis node.
district_farming_spec_commercial_trade_d: Filled with commercial premises and trading incentives, trade districts are hotbeds of commerce.
district_farming_spec_forge_alloy_desc: Tooled for high precision military equipment, many military industrial factories create weaponry and armour within these districts.
district_farming_spec_fortress_crew_desc: The training of new recruits with the skills required to operate in a potentially deadly zero-gravity environment can be undertaken here.
district_farming_undine_desc: Vast reserves of untapped Bio-matter ready to be harvested.
district_generator_spec_fortress_naval_d: Large facilities where spacefaring vessels can be designed and built.
district_generator_spec_retreat_garden_d: Peaceful cultivated gardens given over to ecologically friendly buildings.
district_generator_spec_uni_physics_desc: Campuses focused on high energy physical sciences are situated in this district.
district_generator_underground_desc: Massive subterranean geothermal reactors allow for large amounts of power to pass through these caverns.
district_habitation_node_desc: Alcoves upon alcoves of drones working for the Collective.
district_hive_habitat_desc: An organic compound in which the native species of this planet and commune.
district_mining_cardassian_desc: Within these metallic citadels, the symphony of mechanised labour transforms raw materials into marvels of engineering.
district_mining_lava_desc: Where rare crystals are meticulously honed, their radiant secrets revealed through precision engineering.
district_mining_spec_embassy_embassy_des: Citizens of many species can come to consulates of their own species to resolve administrative and diplomatic issues.
district_mining_spec_resort_cloning_desc: Districts filled with cloning facilities, designed solely for the purpose of propagating more clones.
district_mining_spec_resort_convalance_d: Pure relaxation is the only thing on the minds of those who visit these districts, which are designed to refresh, rejuvenate and invigorate.
district_mining_spec_retreat_artificie_d: High quality skilled craftsworkers known as artificers create unique crafts here.
district_mining_spec_uni_engineering_des: Campuses focused on engineering are situated in this district.
district_mining_underground_desc: Deep rich veins of ore can be found within underground caverns, able to be excavated via specialised machinery.
district_orbital_city_desc: Living quarters fill this area providing homes for the population.
district_research_desc: Many students flock to educational districts, where they can learn from the top minds in their fields, as well as offering a fresh perspective on established research.
district_research_node_desc: Calculations and analysis of relevant data passes through these nodes, researching new improvements and advances.
district_research_spec_commercial_starpo: Trade incentives and lower tariffs make these starport districts ideal for the mass unloading and loading of cargo.
district_research_spec_embassy_diplo_des: Differing environments and needs for numerous species are catered for within diplomatic quarters.
district_research_spec_forge_consumer_de: Dedicated to the construction of consumer goods and supplies, these civilian industries supply vast quantities of everyday items.
district_research_spec_hunting_unity_des: Vast areas dedicated to showcasing the prestige of hunters, from ancient hunters to new freshly blooded ones.
district_research_spec_penal_prison_desc: Large penal complexes provide jobs for prisoners kept on penal worlds.
district_research_spec_penal_slave_desc: Slaves are processed within these vast districts, and assigned to work crews dependant upon their abilities.
district_research_spec_resort_tourist_de: New cultures can be discovered within these districts, whether it's from new culinary delights to strange and wonderful dances.
district_research_spec_uni_society_desc: New technologies, pharmaceuticals and bioengineering designs are tested within these districts, which are dedicated to medical technology.
district_spec_hunting_hunters_desc: Learning the crafts and skills required for a successful hunt can be done on the training grounds.
district_spec_just_mining_desc: Raw materials are extracted from deep within the ground in this district in massive boreholes extending deep under the surface.
district_underground_city_desc: Vast cave networks house massive underground cities, providing protection from above.
holding_cordrazine_mining_facility_desc:
Overlord Building

Catering for the medical needs of both the local population and the overlords workforce, the medical outpost strengthen the bonds between the two states.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_dilithium_mining_facility_desc:
Overlord Building

Dilithium that is harvested on this world is distributed onwards towards the empires overlord.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_embassy_fed_desc:
Overlord Building

Managing the many voices within the Federation requires the careful services from the Federation ambassadorial teams to ensure the member worlds views are heard across the Federation.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_garrison_fed_desc:
Overlord Building

To join the Federation is to place trust in the protection of Starfleet. This local garrison ensures all Federation citizens feel the protective arm of Starfleet.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_garrison_kdf_desc:
Overlord Building

To ensure the loyalty and honorable conduct of their great houses, the placement of a garrison of warriors ready for battle.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_great_halls_kdf_desc:
Overlord Building

The Empire maintains tight control over the all worlds that mend the knee to Qo'noS. The Imperial Halls provide a chance for the Great Houses to liaise with the Imperial might back on the homeworld.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_heavy_water_facility_desc:
Overlord Building

Water that is collected on this world is distributed onwards towards the empires overlord.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_ketracel_mining_facility_desc:
Overlord Building

Production of Ketracel White occurs across the Dominion. Distribution centres ensure that Dominion members play their part in the protection of the Founders.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_labour_camps_desc:
Overlord Building

A labour camp or work camp is a type of prison camp where prisoners are forced to perform labour.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_pergium_mining_facility_desc:
Overlord Building

Pergium that is harvested on this world is distributed onwards towards the empires overlord.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_propaganda_office_dom_desc:
Overlord Building

The might of the Dominion reaches far and wide and the Dominion Outposts ensures that the Founders will is carried out across their member worlds.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_resort_facility_desc:
Overlord Building

This world offers much for offworld visitors, but holds a special place for its overlord.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_satellite_campus_fed_desc:
Overlord Building

A local campus of Starfleet Academy, dedicated to upholding the principles of the Federation. While not the main campus on Earth, this facility serves as a vital facility for training future Starfleet officers, engineers, and scientists. Its curriculum is broad and foundational, instilling the values of diplomacy, exploration, and scientific rigor in the next generation of Starfleet personnel. 

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_spiritualist_shrine_desc:
Overlord Building

A sacred space of quiet contemplation and spiritual reverence. This shrine serves as a focal point for the community's faith, providing a place for adherents to reflect on the core tenets of their belief system and to connect with one another in a shared sense of purpose. While its design may vary widely from culture to culture, its function remains the same: to inspire and unite the faithful in their shared convictions.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_starfleet_science_desc:
Overlord Building

Offworld science research lab associated with the Starfleet Science Division.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_tax_collectors_desc:
Overlord Building

Ensuring a subject's profits are properly taxed is important work. The Overlord's cut of the profit is essential.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_time_crystal_mining_facility_des:
Overlord Building

Rare time crystal's can be a crucial resource to an empire. This facility run by the overlord ensures that any crystals that are found are shared.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
holding_trellium_mining_facility_desc:
Overlord Building

Trellium that is mined across the planet is gathered at this facility and distributed across the empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Overlord Building.
space_building_basic_mine_desc:
Mining Network

A zero gravity bay for the mining and processing of minerals. The basic facilities involve small mining drones capable of bringing asteroids and other foreign bodies inside the bay to be broken down into minerals.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Mining Network.
space_building_generator_water_1_desc:
Manufacturing Building

Drawing ice water from deep under the planet's surface via large pumps provides a large source of ice water to the empire.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Manufacturing Building.
space_building_hydroponics_farm_1_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

The hydroponics dome allows us to grow food on our stations, thereby shedding our reliance on imported food from terrestrial sources. Here, plants are grown without soil by using mineral nutrient solutions in a water solvent.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Hydroponic Farm.
space_building_hydroponics_farm_2_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

By enhancing our hydroponics bays and improving the nutrient solutions in which the plants are grown, we can dramatically improve the crop yield.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Hydroponic Farm.
space_building_hydroponics_farm_3_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

By enhancing our hydroponics bays with high-yielding vegetation, we can support a greater population number on our stations and thus expand our society.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Hydroponic Farm.
space_building_hydroponics_farm_4_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

By enhancing our hydroponics bays with genetically enhanced vegetation suitable for a zero-gravity environment, we can support a greater population number on our stations and thus expand our society.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Hydroponic Farm.
space_building_military_camp_1_voth_desc:
Military Facility

Voth crew and soldiers are trained in this large military barracks complex onboard the City Ship.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
space_building_mining_network_1_desc:
Mining Network

Large advanced drones equipped with drill equipment can scan and separate mineral and ore rich asteroids into easily accessible resources, allowing for the refinement of raw materials into useable goods. 

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Mining Network.
space_building_mining_network_2_desc:
Mining Network

Large complexes allowing for the automated construction of boreholes via drones, deep into the core of mineral rich bodies, drawing rich ores to the surface for easy refinement.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Mining Network.
space_building_mining_network_3_desc:
Mining Network

Powerful particle impellers draw the rich ore and mineral material directly from under the surface, allowing it to be seperated and refined easily.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Mining Network.
space_building_nursery_1_desc:
Population Assembly

A maturation chamber where the young and feeble amongst the species we encounter can be installed with implants that adapt the creatures perfectly to the hive mind.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Population Assembly.
space_building_nursery_2_desc:
Population Assembly

Improvements to the nutrient mixtures and environmental controls in the Borg maturation chambers allow for the accelerated growth of adolescent drones.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Population Assembly.
space_building_nursery_3_desc:
Population Assembly

Improvements to the maturation chambers allow for the accelerated growth of drones, via nutritional supplements fed intravenously to drones from infant ages through to adolescence and maturity.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Population Assembly.
space_building_nursery_4_desc:
Population Assembly

The rapid growth of the new drones requires the creation of nurseries where new drones can be produced en masse. It is outfitted with ideal conditions that can ensure optimal growth for the new drones.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Population Assembly.
space_building_planetary_shield_1_voth_d:
Military Facility

A massive deflector array that projects a field around the hull of the Voth City Ship as it travels through space.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Military Facility.
space_building_queen_1_desc:
Unity Building

A central node which allows for the unified commands of the Collective to be processed and transmitted through it.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
space_building_queen_2_desc:
Unity Building

Numerous uplink nodes can meet in a network junction, where drones from all across an area can utilise shared network to ensure unified harmonisation across an area.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
space_building_queen_3_desc:
Unity Building

Controlling the vast amounts of drone voices within a structure, the system conflux offers a source of unified strength to all who are in proximity to it.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
space_building_queen_4_desc:
Unity Building

The central hub, directly linked to the central harmonisation processor, where all drones can experience the full extent of a collective mind is a great source of unified strength.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
space_building_temporal_1_desc:
Research Facility

A centre for communications that allows messages to be passed through time, allowing our scientists to gain glimpses of the future which aids in their research.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Research Facility.
space_building_undine_1_desc:
Unity Building

Amidst the vastness of space, a hive node stands as a testament to the power of collective thought. Within this epicenter, our individual thoughts harmonise, amplifying our strength and guiding our collective actions with unwavering precision.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Unity Building.
space_building_undine_2_desc:
Unity Building

A hive junction serves as a beacon of unity and purpose for our collective. Here, the hive mind's harmony resonates with amplified intensity, guiding our actions with renewed clarity. Our shared vision, crystallised through this junction, directs our strength towards a common goal, forging an unbreakable bond that echoes through the stars.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Unity Building.
space_building_undine_3_desc:
Unity Building

Representing the pinnacle of our unified power, a hive conflux is a cosmic symphony of minds. Within this grand structure, the collective consciousness soars, unleashing our full potential. It serves as a testament to the strength that arises from unity and the limitless possibilities that our hive-minded synergy unlocks.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Unity Building.
space_building_undine_4_desc:
Unity Building

A hive hub stands as the majestic grand nexus, where the very essence of our collective identity resonates with unwavering intensity. It is within this epicentre that our limitless strength and synergy converge, expanding the boundaries of what a unified force can achieve.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Unity Building.
starfleet_history_museum_desc:
Amenity Building

A Starfleet facility that included a museum as part of the archives, it contains a quantum archive that contained a number of personal effects of active, deceased and retired Starfleet officers as well as galactic wonders collected across the galaxy.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Amenity Building.
temporal_defense_agency_1_desc:
Research Facility

Temporal Defense Authority is dedicated to investigating time travel and other temporal events.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Research Facility.
undine_building_hydroponics_farm_1_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

The core component of the Undine food production process. This unit utilises specialized enzymes to break down organic material, providing the fundamental energy needed for their biostructures.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Hydroponic Farm.
undine_building_hydroponics_farm_2_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

An upgraded nutrient production facility. Instead of simple decomposition, this chamber synthesises complex biomolecules, creating a more efficient and energy-dense nutrient source for the Undine population.

This building is equivalent to a level 2 £ Hydroponic Farm.
undine_building_hydroponics_farm_3_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

A centralised facility designed to rapidly convert and distribute nutrient resources across a colony. Its hyper-efficient metabolic processes allow it to sustain a massive Undine population with minimal resources.

This building is equivalent to a level 3 £ Hydroponic Farm.
undine_building_hydroponics_farm_4_desc:
Hydroponic Farm

An immense biological structure that assimilates a planet's available organic matter and converts it into a universally compatible nutrient source. It represents the ultimate expression of the Undine's bio-engineering superiority.

This building is equivalent to a level 4 £ Hydroponic Farm.
undine_building_nursery_1_desc:
Population Assembly

Undine spawning grounds are a sacred and well guarded location on any Undine infestation. The next generation of warriors are grown and cared for until they are ready to carry on the great purpose.

This building is equivalent to a level 1 £ Population Assembly.
undine_building_nursery_2_desc:
Population Assembly

The improved Undine Hatchery provides greater care for the Undine spawn, allowing them to be tended with more efficiency to produce an even more perfected brood.

This building is equivalent to a level 5 £ Population Assembly.
undine_building_nursery_3_desc:
Population Assembly

The rapid growth of the new Undine spawn requires the creation of nurseries where new hatchlings can be incubated quickly. It is outfitted with ideal conditions that can ensure optimal growth for these new Undine.

This building is equivalent to a level 9 £ Population Assembly.
